art.prompt: Create an original production game illustration atlas for Ashen Covenant, a grounded dark fantasy idle RPG. Landscape canvas 1536x1024, divided into exactly THREE equal WIDTH vertical panels side by side, no borders or gutters. Left panel: human blacksmith woman in practical leather apron at a warm ember forge, a newly forged sword on anvil, battered medieval refuge starting to recover, brass and amber light, hopeful not cheerful. Center panel: solitary hooded traveler seen from behind at stone gate overlooking a ruined drowned cathedral and winding path, cool desaturated teal atmosphere, readable silhouette, distant warm beacon. Right panel: battered armored sentinel kneeling beside a broken bell at sunrise, ash blowing over black volcanic steps, muted burgundy and pale gold rays, solemn victory. Rich material detail, disciplined composition readable at small mobile size, premium narrative RPG concept art, painterly realism, no cartoon, no neon, no text, no lettering, no logos, no UI, no frame, no recognizable existing franchise. Uniform lighting quality and visual language across all three scenes. Save the generated image for project use.
